This metadata record serves as documentation for the authoritative version of the CONUS404 atmospheric forcing dataset. sources.title: Department of the Interior - CONUS404: Four-kilometer long-term ...
sources.snippet: CONUS404 is the successor to the CONUS1 dataset (Liu and others, 2017) with improved representation of weather and climate conditions in the central United States due to the addition of a shallow groundwater module in the Noah-Multiparameterization (Noah-MP) Land Surface Model, among other improvements.
